thesis: Decision-critical operating facts are strongly supported by Visa's FY2025 10-K and Q3 FY2026 10-Q/8-K. Revenue, volume, processed transactions, VAS, OCF, capex, SBC, debt and repurchases are directly observable. The main model uncertainty is the long-run FCF/share growth path and terminal multiple.

evidence.claim: FY2025 revenue, OCF, capex, SBC and repurchases are filing-backed.
Q3/9M revenue, volume, VAS, OCF and repurchases are filing-backed.
5Y valuation percentile is externally sourced and cross-checked with current P/E versus 5Y average.

counterevidence: The 10-year owner-FCF paths are model estimates.
The 5Y percentile source is third-party, not a Visa filing.
falsifiers: Any later filing that materially revises frozen facts requires rerun.
